module: Generic editor ImGui inspector: displays a list of fields (name, type, value, group, id) as collapsible groups with a search filter, expandable arrays and value editors (via editor/api/valueInspector). An editor tool modder uses it to expose arbitrary fields; each modification is passed back to the `fieldSetter` function given to `initialize`. The module returns a constructor with no arguments.
usage:
local gi = require("editor/api/genericInspector")()
gi:initialize(function(fieldName, fieldValue, arrayIndex, customData, editEnded) end)
-- in the window rendering:
gi:inspectorGui(fields)
notes: The constructor does NOT call `init`/`initialize`: `initialize(fieldSetter)` must be called before any use, otherwise valueInspector, fieldNameFilter, etc. are nil.
Fields are sorted by `id` (C++ declaration order), grouped by `groupName` (the last group name encountered is propagated, default "General"), and fields with `hideInInspector` are ignored.
In `inspectorGuiWithFieldCallback`, the test `if #fields then` is always true in Lua (0 is truthy): `inspectorGui` is called even with no fields.
In `inspectorGuiWithFieldCallback`, the loop reads at most 1000 fields; a warning is logged if the 1000th exists (it uses self.valueInspector.inspectorName, so initialize must have been called).

C.desc: Inspector object. After `initialize` it contains valueInspector, fieldSetter, fieldNameFilter (ImGuiTextFilter), inspectorFieldModifiers, etc.

initialize.desc: Prepares the inspector: creates a valueInspector (unique name "genericInspectorN"), the search filter and the ImGui buffers, and hooks `fieldSetter` as the value modification callback.

fieldSetter.desc: function(fieldName, fieldValue, arrayIndex, customData, editEnded) called when the user modifies a field

inspectorGui.desc: Draws the inspector for the given field list: search bar, groups, simple fields, value arrays and field arrays (beginArray type). Shows "<No search matches>" if the filter matches nothing. To be called every frame in the ImGui window.

fields.desc: field list {name, value, type, typeName, id, groupName, fieldDocs, hideInInspector, isArray...}; nil = display nothing

inspectorGuiWithFieldCallback.desc: Builds the field list by calling `fieldCallback(i)` for i = 1, 2, ... until it returns nil (maximum 1000), then calls `inspectorGui`.

fieldCallback.desc: function(index) -> table|nil, returns field number index or nil at the end
